description: This file contains functions for preparing and upgrading Zyxel devices' firmware, including handling partition identification, environment setting, and error handling during device upgrade.

methods.name: zyxel_mstc_prepare_fail
methods.description: Handles failure scenarios during upgrade by rebooting the device after unmounting all filesystems.

methods.name: zyxel_mstc_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for upgrade by checking partition existence, reading boot configuration, and switching boot partitions if necessary.
